create.name: Marcela Lobos
create.bio:
Marcela Lobos is a Chilean teacher of Andean and Amazonian shamanic practice. She left Chile at twenty-one, abandoning a start in journalism, and in California studied yoga and massage before a personal crisis around the age of thirty brought her to the shamanic path. She trained at the Four Winds Society's Light Body School, graduating in 2005, and went on to learn from wisdom keepers of the Peruvian Andes and the Amazon and from native medicine women in Chile; in her forties she took up Tantric Buddhist practice as well. She is now lead faculty and Vision Keeper at the Four Winds Society, and is studying depth psychology.

Her teaching centres on two maps: the Medicine Wheel, a journey through the four directions and their animal guides used for personal renewal, and the Munay-Ki, a series of ten initiatory rites from the Andes that she helped adapt for modern students. She also passes on the Rite of the Womb, a women's initiation. She wrote Awakening Your Inner Shaman and The Sacred Andean Codes, and co-created the Mystical Shaman Oracle deck with her husband, Alberto Villoldo. Together they run Los Lobos Sanctuary, a mountain retreat centre in Chile that hosts residential trainings, and she teaches online and leads seminars and pilgrimages abroad, in English and Spanish.
